build_rpa_reranker: build a RPAReranker agent that reranks dialogue candidates by predicting which character would speak each response
classify_response_with_rpa: classify a dialogue response to determine which character said it using the RPAReranker classify method
augment_context_for_whoami: augment dialogue context with a candidate response and speaker annotations for whoami prediction
predict_character_from_context: predict which character is speaking from dialogue context using the RPAReranker predictor model
batch_classify_responses: batch classify multiple dialogue responses to determine their speaker characters using RPAReranker
